title: The Lead Technician dropdown offers only technicians
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician off, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by nobody (no lead).
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Lead Technician dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The dropdown offers staff member B.
  • Staff member A is not offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R5: “The Lead Technician dropdown on a work order offers only people per S3-R1.”
  • S3-N1: “A person with Technician off, or with Time Clock off, gets no Board View column, no Tech View group, and is not offered in the Technician filter or any technician dropdown, unless S3-E1 or S3-E2 applies.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "6 Technician dropdowns on a work order", pictures "Lead Technician" (This build) and "Lead Technician" (Production today (before))

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p6-02-after-lead-technician.png
  • tt-p6-01-before-lead-technician.png

The design's own words:

  • “Not offered: Parth Fadadu follows Nikola Milosevic. The list holds only staff whose Technician toggle is on and whose Time Clock is on.”
  • “A current lead who is not a technician any more stays the lead, listed last, grayed out with the check, so the current lead never reads as blank (PRD S3-R7).”
  • “Olivia Garrett is a normal, selectable option.”
